texts.zh: 我们收到了来源不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循着某种重复的句法，证明其来源应为智慧生物。我们应进一步研究它。它们似乎集中在一个空间站附近，但尚不清楚这个空间站是不是一个更大的太空文明的一部分。
texts.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single space station, though it is unclear whether this forms part of a larger spacefaring civilization.

texts.zh: 我们探测到了性质不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循某种重复的句法，这可能表明其源自智慧生命。我们应对此进行进一步调查。信号似乎集中在一艘大型舰船周围，但目前尚不清楚这是否属于某个更庞大的星际文明的一部分。
texts.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single large vessel, though it is unclear whether this forms part of a larger spacefaring civilization.
